stories.title: Define Rate Limiting Policy Schema and Configuration Contract
stories.description: Define configurable rate limiting policies including request thresholds, time windows, keying strategy (IP, session, API key), and exemption rules. Establish a schema for configuration and enforcement.

stories.title: Implement Core Rate Limiting Middleware Logic
stories.description: Build middleware to enforce rate limits per defined policy. Track request counts using in-memory store with optional extension to MongoDB, enforce throttling (HTTP 429), and support fixed or sliding window strategies.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (middleware insertion point); Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (pattern for persistence if extended)

stories.title: Integrate Rate Limiting into API Request Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate rate limiting middleware into FastAPI request lifecycle to protect all endpoints including tool_router dispatch and facade entry points. Ensure compatibility with existing error handling and logging.

stories.title: Expose Rate Limit Headers and Client Feedback
stories.description: Return standard rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset) and structured 429 responses. Ensure frontend gracefully handles throttling and displays retry guidance.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx (handles API responses, timeout, and error states)

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Rate Limiting Behavior
stories.description: Create tests validating request threshold enforcement, window resets, concurrent request handling, and exemption rules. Include integration tests across API endpoints and middleware behavior.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py (API testing patterns); Code/Shared/cost_guard.py (limit enforcement testing pattern)
